title: Suite environment requirements v1
description: What a suite revision needs from its environment, secret-free (03.2.1-T4.2, AC8): base URLs, dependency versions, warm-up, the data isolation mode (the single source for 05.7.3-T4) and the NAMES of the secrets the run needs. A secret value never appears here; the semantic secret-shape rules run in addition to this schema.

fixtures.description: The fixtures the run must create before it executes, each pinned at a revision number of a fixture of the suite's own project (03.3.1). The key names the fixture; the number names the immutable version, so a run can never pick up a newer body by accident.
